messages:
alex: heads-up — after the BMC firmware rollout in eu-west (this morning) ~12 p4 nodes started reporting sustained thermal throttling; GPU clocks dropped and throughput down ~35% :thermometer:

sophie: which firmware version? any secure-boot toggles?

alex: not secure-boot. looks like the new image reset a fan policy to 'auto-quiet' on some vendors. IPMI shows weird sensor thresholds. pasting sample output:

alex: ```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-eu-042 -U admin sensor
CPU Temp       | 92 degrees C  | ok
GPU Temp       | 98 degrees C  | ns
Fan1           | 1200 RPM      | lower-non-critical
FanPolicy      | auto-quiet
```

mike: @oncall any active long-running jobs on those nodes? if we lose them we need to evacuate gracefully.

sophie: yes, 5 heavy tensor jobs. recommend immediate fan override to 'full' and start graceful drain for the rest.

ana: runbook note — vendor-specific raw ipmi commands to force full fans: `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x30 0x01 0x01` (test on one node first). DO NOT mass power-cycle; that causes longer downtime on these chassis.

infra-bot: autoscaler: evicting jobs on p4-eu-041..p4-eu-046 (6 nodes) due to throttle alerts

alex: applied the raw command on 6/12 affected nodes. temps dropped to mid-60s on those; remaining nodes show sensor mismatch. collecting BMC logs under /var/log/bmc/fw.log and grabbing serial console dumps.

mike: can we rollback the BMC image to previous stable? which version was that?

alex: previous was 1.2.7, rollout pushed 1.3.0. Rollback requires node reboot and vendor sign-off; I'd prefer fan override + canary rollback for 3 nodes during maintenance window.

sophie: operational impact: approx -8 P4-equivalent capacity in eu-west. autoscaler spun up spots in us-east which increases cross-region cost and egress. tagging cost center for chargeback.

ana: action plan: 1) keep fan override on affected nodes 2) open vendor ticket (INC-4721) with serial logs + firmware diff 3) schedule canary rollback for 3 nodes 02:00-03:00 UTC 4) if rollback fixes sensors, roll forward; if not, vendor escalates hardware replacement

mike: agreed. i'll notify workloads and set maintenance window. add runbook snippets to infra runbook page.

alex: opened INC-4721 with vendor (Supermicro). attached ipmi logs and sample sensor outputs. also added the exact ipmitool commands used.

oncall-bot: maintenance scheduled 2026-03-11T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-11T03:00:00Z. Notifying @search @training teams.

sophie: if we see any flapping or secure-boot toggles flipped, stop the firmware rollout immediately and revert.

alex: TL;DR — BMC firmware changed fan policy default -> thermal throttle -> mitigation: ipmitool fan override; canary rollback planned; vendor ticket opened. Will update thread with results and if any node needs RMA.
